name: MrCrippy

latest.title: All Aboard
notes: Buses, trains and ferries you can actually ride: buy a ticket at the stop, wait for it to pull in, hop on and ride along (or doze off until your stop)
Paved two-lane roads with sidewalks between towns, a bus stop in every town and bus lines linking them
Railways now go around towns and you can see the tracks; ferries sail between harbour towns
Vehicles keep to their lane and wait for people and each other instead of driving through them
Your existing world gets the new roads and lines the first time you load it

message: Thanks for playing MrCrippy! New versions install right from the game.
